Our Journey

From 1997 to a National Name

1997

The Beginning

Saffron comes into being as a marketing company — and extends its reach to every suburb of Pakistan.

2006

Purpose-Built Plant

A state-of-the-art manufacturing facility rises at 19-Km Sheikhupura Road, Faisalabad — built strictly to WHO cGMP norms.

2007

Own Manufacturing

Saffron starts production in its own plant, using novel technology and PLC-controlled machines with integrated packaging lines.

2009

Best GMP Facility

The Ministry of Health, Islamabad awards Saffron the Best GMP Compliant Facility certificate.

Today

Certified & Growing

ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO/IEC 17025 certified — with a dedicated Cephalosporin plant and nationwide distribution.

Manufacturing Facilities

Two Plants. Every Dosage Form.

🏭 Main Plant — Faisalabad

High-volume production across every major dosage form, run on modern PLC-controlled machines with integrated packaging lines under strict cGMP.
